title: Pokemon TCG Japanese Garganacl Mega Brave 070/063 Holo Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The Garganacl 070/063 Pokémon TCG M1l Mega Brave Art Rare Holo card is a highly sought-after collectible for fans of the Pokémon franchise. Featuring the character Garganacl with a rock creature type and high HP of 180, this Japanese card from 2023 is illustrated by Yano Keiji and manufactured by The Pokémon Company. With a powerful attack power of 130 and requiring 2 Colorless, 1 Fighting type costs, this Stage 2 Pokémon card is a valuable addition to any collector's deck, boasting a rare Art Rare finish and holo finish for a stunning appearance.
